analysis.reason: RSI 58.8에서 66.0으로 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. 5일 연속 Higher Low 패턴이 지속되며 상승 추세 유지. MACD 히스토그램은 6.3757에서 4.7710으로 악화되었으나, RSI 상승세가 이를 상쇄하는 국면.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 58.8 to 66.0, confirming an exit from oversold territory. The Higher Low pattern has persisted for 5 consecutive days, maintaining the uptrend. Although the MACD histogram worsened from 6.3757 to 4.7710, the RSI's upward momentum offsets this in the current phase.

· Position vs SMA100/200 ($549.73/$456.16): Mid-to-long-term trend strength maintained.
· 52-week position (82.7%) + Current price level near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (58.8→66.0): Exited oversold, entering neutral zone, upward momentum confirmed.
· MACD histogram trajectory (6.3757→4.7710): Bearish convergence in progress, short-term momentum slowing.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $605.72): Approaching upper band, caution for overheating.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($536.12): Support strength confirmed based on SMA50.
· Swing resistance ($618.84): Considering potential decline from 52-week high.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (Higher Low continues): Signal of strengthening uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): Entry based on RSI uptrend and Higher Low pattern; slowing short-term momentum and low volume are risk factors.
